artist_notes.note: Could not verify a meaningful public profile — limited information available; included on billing.

artist_notes.name: american woman
artist_notes.note: Could not verify a meaningful public profile — included on billing.

orion_224_cannon_the_dealers_moroccan_lo.curator_note: Three bands at the Moroccan Lounge, which is always a good room for this format, but none of the acts have enough of a public profile to judge the night on. Worth checking their Bandcamp or Spotify before committing.
orion_224_cannon_the_dealers_moroccan_lo.description: Three-band indie rock bill with Orion 224, Cannon the Dealers, and American Woman at the Moroccan Lounge in the Arts District, 9:30pm.

artist_notes.name: Sindri
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ active on the queer underground circuit, with appearances at Akbar including the SUSPIRIA! Halloween event — limited wider public footprint; local and community-rooted.

artist_notes.name: Mondo Nexus
artist_notes.note: Could not verify a public profile for Mondo Nexus — limited information available; included on billing.

sebastiane_sindri_mondo_nexus_akbar_2026.curator_note: SEBASTIANE is Akbar's recurring queer night — a Silver Lake institution in a small, unpretentious room that's never trying to be a big club. The lineup here is local, so the draw is the room itself rather than the billing.
sebastiane_sindri_mondo_nexus_akbar_2026.description: SEBASTIANE queer electronic night at Akbar in Silver Lake with DJs Sindri and Mondo Nexus, starting 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Enola Bedard
artist_notes.note: Quebec-born singer-songwriter with a large TikTok following — viral acoustic covers launched her career, now releasing original indie pop material. A pop act on the younger-fanbase end of the spectrum; not the lane.

enola_bedard_north_america_tour_teragram.curator_note: Enola Bedard built her following through viral covers and is now doing a proper North America tour — she's a pop act for a younger demographic, and Teragram is probably the right-sized room for that. Outside the lane.
enola_bedard_north_america_tour_teragram.description: Quebec singer-songwriter Enola Bedard plays a solo pop/indie concert at the Teragram Ballroom in Westlake, 8pm.

artist_notes.name: DJ Slugo
artist_notes.note: One of the founding fathers of Chicago ghetto house and juke — 30+ years deep, CEO of Blok Club DJs, and a defining force in the raw 150-165 BPM body-music that predated and shaped footwork. Tracks like 'Where the Rats?' are canonical. A genuine originator, not a tourist.

baile_world_dj_slugo_tba_dtla_2026-08-01.curator_note: BAILE WORLD booking DJ Slugo is a curatorial swing — he's a Chicago ghetto house and juke originator, not someone who plays the usual underground circuit, and that raw BPM energy at a TBA DTLA late night is a genuinely different proposition from the deep-house and techno you usually run toward.
baile_world_dj_slugo_tba_dtla_2026-08-01.description: BAILE WORLD presents Chicago ghetto house and juke pioneer DJ Slugo at a secret DTLA location, starting 11pm.

artist_notes.name: Scotty Boy
artist_notes.note: Veteran DJ/producer Scott Schroer — 25+ years in the scene, three Billboard Dance #1s (including 'Shiny Disco Balls', 2014), Sirius XM radio, and Kiss Kiss Bang Bang resident. More polished and radio-house than underground; solid crowd-mover without much edge.

paradisco_scotty_boy_kiss_kiss_bang_bang.curator_note: Scotty Boy is a commercial house name with real longevity and three Billboard #1s — Kiss Kiss Bang Bang's Paradisco format is fun but runs toward polished club rather than the underground groove end. Good if you want a no-drama Saturday; less so if you want something to surprise you.
paradisco_scotty_boy_kiss_kiss_bang_bang.description: Paradisco recurring disco and house night at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang in Koreatown with Scotty Boy, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: EMBRZ
artist_notes.note: Dublin producer Jack Casey — 100M+ streams and BBC Radio 1 attention for his wistful, atmospheric take on melodic deep house; has toured with Lane 8 and SG Lewis and runs in the This Never Happened circuit. Not underground, but the rooftop day-party format suits his slow-burning style.

embrz_harbor_house_rooftop_dtla_2026-08-.curator_note: EMBRZ on a Saturday afternoon rooftop in DTLA is a natural fit — his melodic, atmospheric deep house is essentially made for that golden-hour setting. Not the underground end of the lane, but this is one where the format and the artist actually match.
embrz_harbor_house_rooftop_dtla_2026-08-.description: Irish melodic deep house producer EMBRZ plays an afternoon rooftop set at Harbor House DTLA, starting 5pm.

artist_notes.name: Isaac Carter
artist_notes.note: London-based selector and Ochi imprint founder — deep Chicago- and Detroit-inflected vocal house with a contemporary UK edge; championed by Ben UFO, Joy Orbison, Seth Troxler and Floating Points. He has an EP forthcoming on Bradley Zero's Rhythm Section label in 2026 — as inside the groove/European taste lane as a non-tracked name gets.

artist_notes.name: Harrison BDP
artist_notes.note: Welsh producer Harrison Webber — outsider house, tech house and deep house on Shall Not Fade, Lost Palms and Phonica Recordings; NTS regular. A digger-oriented sound with some Glaswegian warehouse energy.

artist_notes.name: Lubelski
artist_notes.note: LA native Jake Lubell — Dirtybird LP 'Happy Accidents' (2022), releases on Crosstown Rebels, Gruuv and Desert Hearts; percussive, analog-obsessed production and a Midnight Lovers fixture. One of the better local selectors.

midnight_lovers_isaac_carter_harrison_bd.curator_note: Isaac Carter having an EP dropping on Rhythm Section in 2026 makes this a genuinely well-curated bill rather than a lucky Midnight Lovers pick — he's exactly the vocal deep house sound that connects Bradley Zero's world to a proper London underground sensibility. The TBA format keeps the room honest.
midnight_lovers_isaac_carter_harrison_bd.description: Midnight Lovers afterhours at a TBA DTLA location with Isaac Carter, Harrison BDP and Lubelski, starting midnight.

artist_notes.name: Phantoms
artist_notes.note: LA duo Kyle Kaplan and Vinnie Pergola — former teen actors turned electronic producers; their blend of house, indie-dance and French Touch pop sensibility earned 'Just A Feeling' (ft. VERITE) four weeks at US Dance Radio #1 and worldwide DJ support from Pete Tong and Diplo. Now on Ninja Tune. Fun and radio-friendly rather than underground.

phantoms_pool_party_level_8_dtla_2026-08.curator_note: A Phantoms pool party at Level 8 on a Saturday afternoon — the format is right but the act skews toward the indie-dance pop end rather than the groove-selector lane. If you're at Level 8 anyway for the setting, this works; if you're picking specifically for music, Midnight Lovers that same night is a better call.
phantoms_pool_party_level_8_dtla_2026-08.description: LA electronic duo Phantoms headline a pool party at Level 8 DTLA, 2pm on Saturday August 8.

karol_g_tropitour_sofi_stadium_2026-08-1.curator_note: Karol G at SoFi is a full stadium reggaeton production — she's a massive artist in your Spotify rotation and this is a major touring show. Not the music lane, but if you're going for the spectacle and the crowd, it delivers on that.
karol_g_tropitour_sofi_stadium_2026-08-1.description: Colombian reggaeton star Karol G brings the VIAJANDO POR EL MUNDO TROPITOUR to SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, Friday August 14, 7pm.

artist_notes.name: DJ Rashida
artist_notes.note: Detroit-connected selector who toured globally as Prince's personal DJ — her eclecticism spans hip-hop, funk, soul, dancehall and house, and she has deep personal knowledge of the Prince catalog from years on the road with him. An ideal co-curator for this night.

moodymann_dj_rashida_play_prince_regent_.curator_note: Moodymann playing Prince records with the DJ who actually toured with Prince — this is a rare and genuinely meaningful pairing rather than a tribute cash-in. Kenny Dixon Jr.'s own funk-and-soul sensibility maps naturally onto Prince's catalog, and The Regent is the right-sized room for it.
moodymann_dj_rashida_play_prince_regent_.description: Moodymann and DJ Rashida co-headline a Prince tribute DJ night at The Regent Theater in DTLA, 9pm.

paradisco_kiss_kiss_bang_bang_2026-08-15.curator_note: The August 15 Paradisco edition with no headliner billed — recurring disco and house format at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang. Without a named DJ, this is filler unless you're already in Koreatown.
paradisco_kiss_kiss_bang_bang_2026-08-15.description: Paradisco recurring disco and house night at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang in Koreatown, starting 10pm — no headliner announced.

artist_notes.name: Man Man
artist_notes.note: Philadelphia-born, now LA-based experimental indie band led by Honus Honus — known for switching instruments mid-set and channeling Beefheart, Zappa and Tom Waits through dense, theatric indie rock. Sub Pop release 'Carrot on Strings' dropped June 2024. Exactly the small-venue experimental-band lane taste.yaml wants surfaced.

man_man_american_tomahawk_echoplex_2026-.curator_note: Man Man at the Echoplex is squarely in the live-band lane — Honus and crew do this lurching, Captain Beefheart-adjacent rock that's weird in the right way and best seen in a room this size. Their 2024 Sub Pop record is good, and the Echoplex sound is right for them.
man_man_american_tomahawk_echoplex_2026-.description: Philadelphia experimental indie band Man Man (Sub Pop) headlines the Echoplex in Echo Park with openers American Tomahawk, 7pm.

karol_g_tropitour_sofi_stadium_2026-08-1.curator_note: Second night of Karol G's SoFi run — same production as the Friday. If you're going, the Saturday typically has a slightly looser crowd energy than a Friday opener.
karol_g_tropitour_sofi_stadium_2026-08-1.description: Karol G continues the VIAJANDO POR EL MUNDO TROPITOUR at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, Saturday August 15, 7pm.

jason_bonham_led_zeppelin_evening_vina_r.curator_note: Jason Bonham (John Bonham's son) has been running this Led Zeppelin tribute circuit for years — technically skilled but firmly in the tribute/cover territory that taste.yaml explicitly down-ranks, and Paso Robles is a haul. Pass unless this is specifically someone's request.
jason_bonham_led_zeppelin_evening_vina_r.description: Jason Bonham's Led Zeppelin Evening — a touring Led Zeppelin tribute show — at the Vina Robles Amphitheatre in Paso Robles, 7:30pm.

artist_notes.name: Oguz
artist_notes.note: Dutch-born DJ of Turkish descent (Oguz Gülcenbay) — hard techno with melodic crossover moments; played Berghain, Printworks, Hï Ibiza; 'GOLDEN SZN' cleared 20M streams. Skews harder and more festival-EDM-adjacent than the refined European techno end you typically favor.

mutate_oguz_2026-08-22_exchange_la.curator_note: Mutate is Exchange LA's harder techno night, and Oguz leans into the hard/melodic-techno overlap that draws big crowds but not the stripped, functional kind you'd prefer from a Robert Hood or Stacey Pullen. Worth knowing about if you want peak-time energy without the underground circuit.
mutate_oguz_2026-08-22_exchange_la.description: Exchange LA's Mutate night featuring Dutch-Turkish techno DJ Oguz, 10pm, afterhours.

artist_notes.name: Tucker Wetmore
artist_notes.note: Rising Bellingham, WA country-pop singer — 'Wine Into Whiskey,' 'Island'; Warner Nashville signee on a breakout trajectory; mainstream country with some heartland-rock edge.

artist_notes.name: William Beckmann
artist_notes.note: Texas singer-songwriter in the traditional country mold — warm baritone, straightforward country songcraft with an honky-tonk lean.

tucker_wetmore_brunette_world_tour_2026-.curator_note: Way outside the electronic lane — this is mainstream rising country at an Paso Robles amphitheater. Surfaced because of strong Spotify rotation on Tucker Wetmore; treat it as a heads-up, not a recommendation.
tucker_wetmore_brunette_world_tour_2026-.description: Tucker Wetmore's Brunette World Tour stop at Vina Robles Amphitheatre in Paso Robles, with William Beckmann and Stella Lefty, 6:30pm.

artist_notes.name: Noizu
artist_notes.note: UK-born (Jacob Plant), LA-based tech house producer — broke through on Chris Lake's Black Book Records with 'DANCE' (2019); OWSLA/Confession credits; runs his own Techné Records. Hard-hitting festival-ready tech house, firmly in the mainstream-fun end of the lane.

noizu_2026-08-22_shrine_expo_hall.curator_note: Noizu at the Shrine is a big-room tech house night — the same mainstream-fun tier as FISHER or John Summit, so go in for the hands-up energy. The Shrine is a cavernous room; works better when you want a crowd experience than a selectors' night.
noizu_2026-08-22_shrine_expo_hall.description: Noizu (tech house, Black Book Records) headlines Shrine Expo Hall in University Park, 9pm.

artist_notes.name: Rachel Chinouriri
artist_notes.note: Zimbabwean-British singer-songwriter from Croydon — debut album 'What a Devastating Turn of Events' (Parlophone, 2024) charted UK top 20 and landed her two BRIT nominations (Best New Artist, Artist of Year). Warm, confessional indie-pop with a soulful British sensibility.

artist_notes.name: KATSEYE
artist_notes.note: Six-piece global girl group formed via the HYBE x Geffen 'Dream Academy' reality show (2023) — blends K-pop production values with Western pop; debut Billboard Hot 100 entry in 2025. More K-pop adjacent than indie or alternative.

artist_notes.name: Doechii
artist_notes.note: Tampa rapper and Grammy winner (Best Rap Album 2025 for 'Alligator Bites Never Heal') — genre-fluid, confrontational, genuinely one of the most exciting MCs in the game right now.

daisy_chain_fields_music_festival_2026-0.curator_note: Olivia Rodrigo's curated all-women festival is a genuinely impressive cultural event — Bikini Kill, Garbage, Mitski, The Breeders, Santigold, and Doechii on one bill is not a throwaway lineup. Mostly outside the electronic lane but worth having on the radar for the occasion.
daisy_chain_fields_music_festival_2026-0.description: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival at Great Park in Irvine — an all-women-curated lineup including Chappell Roan, Doechii, Mitski, Bikini Kill, Garbage, Santigold, The Breeders, Karen O, Stevie Nicks and more; 100% of net proceeds to nonprofits supporting women and girls. From $250.

artist_notes.name: Noname
artist_notes.note: Chicago rapper Fatima Warner — Bronzeville-raised, started in YOUMedia alongside Chance the Rapper; 'Telefone' (2016) and 'Room 25' (2018) cemented her as one of the most distinct voices in conscious hip-hop; soft-spoken delivery over jazzy basslines, politically sharp lyrics. Also runs the Noname Book Club, a globally active radical reading group.

noname_2026-09-01_the_fonda_theatre.curator_note: Noname at the Fonda is one of the more genuinely interesting live hip-hop bookings in LA this fall — her shows are intimate in spirit even when the room is full, and she plays the Fonda well. Not the dance lane, but a strong Spotify rotation and real artistic weight make this worth the detour.
noname_2026-09-01_the_fonda_theatre.description: Chicago conscious rapper Noname performs at The Fonda Theatre in Hollywood, 8pm, September 1.

artist_notes.name: DJ Susan
artist_notes.note: San Diego-based DJ/producer Steven Glathe — 3 Billboard Dance chart #1s ('Shiny Disco Balls,' 'You're Not Alone,' 'Shine Your Love'); known for mixing deep, jackin and bass house; created the 'Deep House Brunch DTLA' series. More festival/mainstream tech-house than the digger-vinyl end.

dj_susan_pool_party_level_8_labor_day_20.curator_note: Level 8's Labor Day pool party is the right format — but DJ Susan lands in the festival-tech-house zone rather than the vinyl-groove vibe of Sunset Sessions. Fun if you want to close out summer with a crowd; temper expectations on the selection depth.
dj_susan_pool_party_level_8_labor_day_20.description: DJ Susan headlines a Labor Day Saturday pool party at Level 8 DTLA, 2pm, daytime.

artist_notes.name: Scotty Boy
artist_notes.note: Veteran LA-based DJ/producer Scott Schroer, 25+ years in the game — multiple Billboard Dance chart #1s; runs the Paradisco and Deep House Brunch DTLA events; mixes deep, jackin and nu-disco house. A genuine LA scene fixture more than a hyped import.

paradisco_scotty_boy_2026-09-19_kiss_kis.curator_note: Paradisco is Scotty Boy's own night at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang — a reliable Koreatown late-nighter in the disco-house groove that's more fun than fashionable. The afterhours timing and disco-leaning format is right for that part of the taste; don't expect underground cred, just a solid dancefloor.
paradisco_scotty_boy_2026-09-19_kiss_kis.description: Paradisco with DJ/producer Scotty Boy at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang, Koreatown, 10pm, afterhours.

overmono_pure_devotion_world_tour_2026-0.curator_note: Overmono's Pure Devotion world tour is their biggest production yet — brothers Tom and Ed Russell have been one of the best live electronic acts since their 'Everything U Need' breakthrough, and the Hollywood Palladium is a room that fits their scale without swallowing the intimacy. A tracked act worth prioritizing.
overmono_pure_devotion_world_tour_2026-0.description: Welsh electronic duo Overmono (Tom & Ed Russell, XL Recordings) play their Pure Devotion World Tour at Hollywood Palladium, Hollywood, September 25, 8pm. New album drops August 7, 2026.

artist_notes.name: Rich Medina
artist_notes.note: Philadelphia selector with one of the widest musical vocabularies in American DJing — Cornell-educated, BBE Music-affiliated; built his reputation on JNF (North America's original Fela Kuti-dedicated Afrobeat party), Lil' Ricky's Rib Shack at NYC's APT, and collaborations with Jill Scott and J Dilla. House, rare groove, soul, Afrobeat and garage classics all in a single night. 50,000+ pieces of vinyl and counting.

rich_medina_home_all_night_set_2026-09-2.curator_note: Rich Medina all-night at High Tide is one of those sets you hear about afterward and wish you'd gone — he pulls across house, garage classics and rare groove with the encyclopedic confidence of someone who's been doing this since before most of the crowd was born. The title 'HOME' suggests he's playing his own curation, not a requests-and-hits crowd-pleaser.
rich_medina_home_all_night_set_2026-09-2.description: Philadelphia DJ Rich Medina plays an all-night set spanning house, rare groove, Afrobeat and garage classics at High Tide, Los Angeles, 10pm, Saturday September 26.

artist_notes.name: Adam Auburn
artist_notes.note: LA-based house DJ and event producer — runs Auburn Events (Afternoon Delight parties), 15+ years on the LA scene; played alongside John Digweed, Hot Since 82, Martinez Brothers; an Insomniac main-stage regular and one of the city's more versatile house selectors.

day_trip_in_the_park_la_armand_van_helde.curator_note: Day Trip's park format is reliable — open-air Chinatown with Armand Van Helden (a house legend whose selections still hold up) and a solid local supporting cast. The Sunday afternoon timing and outdoor setting make it the loose, groove-forward option for the weekend.
day_trip_in_the_park_la_armand_van_helde.description: Day Trip In The Park LA presents Armand Van Helden headlining LA State Historic Park alongside James Poole, Adam Auburn and Athena, Sunday September 27, 2pm, outdoor.

artist_notes.name: Dublon
artist_notes.note: Oslo-based producer — jazz-inflected, feel-good melodic house; debut EP 'Nectar' on Delicieuse Musique, now on Ninja Tune's Technicolour imprint. Tracks like 'Summer in Marseille' and 'Belle' broke on TikTok; warm, speckled compositions that sit closer to listening-bar house than peak-time techno.

dublon_rooftop_party_2026-10-09_harbor_h.curator_note: Dublon's rooftop at Harbor House is a genuine fit — Norwegian jazz-house with an Ninja Tune/Technicolour pedigree in an open-air DTLA setting at 5pm is exactly the Balearic-leaning early-evening groove format this taste is built for.
dublon_rooftop_party_2026-10-09_harbor_h.description: Norwegian jazz-house DJ and producer Dublon plays a rooftop set at Harbor House DTLA, 5pm, Friday October 9.

artist_notes.name: Aaron Paar
artist_notes.note: LA DJ since the early '90s, active in the city's soul/house underground ever since — Dublab-associated, vinyl-forward selector with a deep crate spanning soul, funk and house. A scene elder in the best sense.

artist_notes.name: Clint Stewart
artist_notes.note: Sunday Sessions LA vinyl-only resident — local house and deep house selector on the vinyl-only LA circuit.

artist_notes.name: yoffers
artist_notes.note: LA-based vinyl house DJ on the Sunday Sessions circuit; limited wider public footprint beyond the local underground scene.

sunday_sessions_la_vinyl_only_open_air_2.curator_note: Sunday Sessions has built a real identity as the biggest vinyl-only house series in the US — the Bridge outdoor format with Aaron Paar anchoring is the version of this you want. A genuine all-wax Sunday wind-down that earns its reputation.
sunday_sessions_la_vinyl_only_open_air_2.description: Sunday Sessions LA vinyl-only open-air house party at The Bridge, DTLA, with yoffers, Aaron Paar and Clint Stewart, from 6pm, Sunday June 28.

bass_recovery_day_2_unofficial_apocalyps.curator_note: Free recovery rave at a DTLA warehouse — the name (Apocalypse Recovery Party) and 23:45 start say everything you need to know about the vibe. No lineup detail in the record, so this is a trust-the-promoter call; The LA Raver x Rave Haven know their crowd.
bass_recovery_day_2_unofficial_apocalyps.description: Bass Recovery Day 2 — unofficial post-Apocalypse festival recovery party at a DTLA warehouse presented by The LA Raver x Rave Haven, featuring APx1, Novella, Catnap, Phayla and Kaali; free entry, 11:45pm, Sunday June 28.

nightshift_after_hours_2026-06-28_the_le.curator_note: Blind Tiger's Nightshift at The Lexington is a DTLA afterhours with a familiar format — 11pm to 5am, free with RSVP before 1am. No lineup in the listing, so it's a walk-in-and-see proposition; the Blind Tiger brand has a solid local following but the lineup gap is real.
nightshift_after_hours_2026-06-28_the_le.description: NIGHTSHIFT afterhours at The Lexington, DTLA, presented by Blind Tiger — 11pm to 5am, free with RSVP before 1am, $23 after.

dj nuts.note: Sao Paulo crate-digger revered for his Brazilian/global-beats edits (Wax Poetics 'Cultura Copia' mixtapes) — deep, eclectic, all-vinyl selector.

cut chemist.note: LA turntablist, ex-Jurassic 5 / Ozomatli — sample-collage funk and breaks; a foundational figure in the city's beats scene.

waajeed.note: Detroit producer/DJ (Bling47, Dirt Tech Reck) and Slum Village affiliate — soulful house and beats that bridge Dilla's lineage into the dancefloor.

shdw.note: Co-founder of the Mutual Rytm label and half of German duo SHDW & Obscure Shape — driving, hypnotic, melodic-leaning techno; squarely the refined European end you like.

bradley zero.note: Founder of Peckham's Rhythm Section International and the long-running NTS show — a genuine tastemaker selector spanning disco, broken beat, deep house and global grooves. One of the better daytime sets you can catch in LA this weekend.

masha mar.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

neeko.note: Resident selector for Sunday Sessions LA, the vinyl-only series at Apotheke — all-wax house and disco.

krane.note: Longtime Sunday Sessions LA resident — vinyl-only house DJ recorded across the series' open-air sets.

ayybo.note: Rising US tech-house producer, big-room festival energy — exactly the mainstream-fun end of the lane, not noise.

ragie ban.note: Brazilian house producer signed to Lake's own Black Book; their flip 'Toxic' hit Beatport #1.

dj minx.note: Detroit house matriarch, Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; deep, soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

josh caffé.note: London house vocalist/DJ and Paranoid London frontman; Black queer club energy with records on Crosstown Rebels and Classic — proper fabric-lineage stuff.

farralone.note: LA disco/house selector — couldn't verify a label home, but the billing reads classic nu-disco-into-house warmth.

trovarsi.note: LA modular/live techno artist and educator (SoCal Synth Society) — bassy, hardware-driven sets that swing from pounding to melodic.

e m bae.note: Part of the Black Techno Matters collective lineup; couldn't verify a full bio, so taking that at face value.

92jelani.note: Black Techno Matters-affiliated DJ; limited public footprint, included per the billing.

hot since 82.note: UK house heavyweight, Knee Deep In Sound boss — tracked artist; rolling, hypnotic, extended-set sensibility that elevates the whole bill.

claude vonstroke.note: Dirtybird founder (aka Barclay Crenshaw) — playful, bass-heavy West Coast house; he's billed leading the 'Team USA' set here.

ardalan.note: Tehran-born, Bay Area-raised Dirtybird mainstay — hypnotic, deep-bass house out of the Sunset Sound System lineage.

todd edwards.note: New Jersey UK-garage legend ('God of Garage') who shaped Daft Punk's sound — chopped-vocal, skippy house.

cut snake.note: Australian house duo (Sedz & Leigh Sedley) — sunny, festival-ready CRSSD-circuit house.

falcons.note: LA producer/DJ working the club-and-bass-leaning end; included per the bill.

ak chamel the giver of illness.note: Anonymous Houston duo doing desert-scorched ritual-folk and lo-fi psychedelia — masked, costumed, occult live show; fits the Zebulon experimental lane more than the dance one.

derek monypeny.note: Joshua Tree guitarist/oud + shahi baaja player (ex-Sir Richard Bishop's Freak of Araby Ensemble) — drone-to-free-jazz 'desert continuum' soundscapes.

xica soul.note: LA DJ and radio host (Artform, KQBH) — soul, funk and house, an In Sheep's Clothing-circuit selector.

cassian.note: Australian producer, Grammy-winning mixer on RÜFÜS DU SOL's 'Alive' — dark-but-dreamy melodic house; the marquee draw here.

kamino.note: London/LA/Brooklyn house & tech-house producer; broke out with 'Lower Frequency,' melody-forward but dancefloor-aimed.

eddie c.note: Canadian-in-Berlin slo-mo disco-edits heavyweight (Edward Currelly) — lush, dubby, generous grooves on Endless Flight; runs the 7 Inches of Love imprint with The Mole. A tracked name and a perfect open-to-close selector.

b wade.note: Resident behind the recurring 'Acts of Service Sounds' soulful-house night at Gold Diggers — 'sounds for the soul, all night long,' classic vocal/gospel-tinged deep house.

lydo.note: NYC-based, BASEMENT resident and X-TRA.SERVICES founder — fast, syncopated, heady techno-trance from the queer underground.

frankie teardrop.note: Montreal DJ/curator (Slut Island festival, LIP party) — high-energy queer-underground techno and rave.

tamara lanza.note: LA multi-genre DJ and Level 8 / Sunset Sessions regular — ranges disco house through deep and melodic; reliable rooftop-groove selector.

antal.note: Rush Hour co-founder, Amsterdam — one of the deepest diggers alive; obscure disco, raw house, broken beat and beyond. Flying in for this. A tracked name.

reverberation radio.note: The Allah-Las' long-running weekly podcast and DJ crew — deep-crate '60s-onward psych, surf, folk-rock, soul and global obscurities played off the records (Calico Discos label).

richie hawtin.note: Windsor/Detroit-Berlin minimal-techno icon (Plastikman, F.U.S.E.; founder of Plus 8 and M_nus) — a defining name in stripped, hypnotic techno. A tracked name; this is a free art-context set, not a club.

john gerrard.note: Irish artist behind LACMA's year-long browser-based 'SPIRITS' artwork; this solstice event is its Summer (Mediterranean) activation — gerrard appears alongside Hawtin.

dave harrington.note: Half of Darkside (with Nicolas Jaar) and a fixture of LA's improv scene — guitar/electronics-led psychedelic jams; this is his quintet.

john dwyer.note: Frontman of Oh Sees / Osees — prolific garage-psych and experimental bandleader (Castle Face Records), here in a free-improv setting.

spencer zahn.note: Composer and double-bassist working in ambient-jazz and modern-classical textures (collaborations with Dawn Richard among others).

aaron steele.note: LA/Nashville drummer-percussionist (Chrome Sparks and others) — versatile, jazz-fusion-leaning player.

tom dolas.note: Keyboardist in Oh Sees and Mr. Elevator — psych and jazz-fusion-flavored synth and keys.

yaeji.note: Brooklyn-based, Korean-American producer/DJ (Kathy Yaeji Lee) — whispered bilingual vocals over deep house and club rhythms; debut LP 'What We Drew' on XL Recordings, second album 'With A Hammer' (2023). Breakthrough Boiler Room in 2017. On a dedicated DJ-set North American summer tour 2026. Tracked name.

alima lee.note: LA-based DJ and co-founder of the Baexploitation / Hood Rave orbit — global club, footwork-adjacent and deeply communal sets.

adam beyer.note: Swedish techno institution and Drumcode founder — driving, functional, peak-time techno; one of the most reliably excellent festival techno sets alive. Tracked name.

cloonee.note: Manchester-raised tech-house producer Dave Bissett (CLNE, Repopulate Mars, Sola) — Beatport #1s including 'Like What' and a Chris Lake collab 'Nightmares'; one of the circuit's best crowd-movers. Tracked name.

loco dice.note: Tunisian-German DJ Yassine Ben Achour, Düsseldorf — founder of Desolat; Space/Hi Ibiza resident; blends hip-hop textures and North African rhythms into house and tech house. Records on Ovum, M-nus, Cadenza, Cocoon.

hi-lo.note: Oliver Heldens' darker techno alias — HILOMATIK label boss; has released on Drumcode and deadmau5's mau5trap; melodic-peak techno bridging festival and underground.

elderbrook.note: London singer-producer Alexander Kotz — 'Cola' with CamelPhat was Grammy-nominated 2018; soulful voice over emotive deep house. Live-electronic act, not a DJ set.

hayden james.note: Sydney producer — polished, melodic house (multi-Platinum 'Something About You'); worked with Gorgon City and Katy Perry; RUFUS Du Sol-adjacent but slightly more radio-pop.

sidepiece.note: LA-based duo Party Favor + Nitti Gritti — their 2019 'On My Mind' was Grammy-nominated for Best Dance Recording; peak-time tech house with Motown and '90s soul edits.

westend.note: New York tech house producer Tyler Morris — helped define modern American tech house; Kick & Bass Records founder; recent single 'The Ceiling' on John Summit's Experts Only.

josh baker.note: Manchester DJ/producer and You&Me Records founder — groove-heavy fluid house and minimal; played fabric, DC10, The Warehouse Project; also runs SYNTHO production school.

riordan.note: South-coast UK rising producer — garage-influenced tech house; Beatport #1 'Needle On The Record' on Gorgon City's Realm; also on Black Book and Catch & Release.

greg 99.note: Brazilian producer from Minas Gerais — Latin and Afro-inflected tech house; Beatport #1 collab 'Still My Baby' with Cloonee (6.6M streams); Insomniac Records debut.

stacey pullen.note: Second-wave Detroit techno architect — studied under Derrick May, released on R&S, Transmat and Eclipse in the '90s; Blackflag Recordings founder; acclaimed DJ-Kicks (1996); also releases as Bango, Kosmik Messenger and Silent Phase. Tracked name.

bae bae.note: Kumi James — LA-born DJ/producer, sound artist, Planet Mu signee, and co-founder of Hood Rave (DTLA's queer-Black underground party). Sets weave footwork, juke, breaks and R&B through an explicitly Black-diasporic and femme lens; NTS and Dublab radio host.

nish.note: LA/Boracay-raised DJ — groove-forward soulful house and global rhythms with an intention-first approach; active in the Westside Bounce and LA underground circuits.

dj toka.note: Resident at Sudamericana, LA's long-running Latin dance party (founded 2012) — plays between classic South American rhythms, house and disco edits in an unpretentious, inclusive room.

robert hood.note: Detroit minimal-techno originator and M-Plant founder — co-founded Underground Resistance with Jeff Mills and Mad Mike Banks; stripped techno to bare drum/bassline essentials on 'Internal Empire' and 'Minimal Nation' (both 1994, Tresor/Axis). Also records as Floorplan (gospel-inflected house). Tracked name.

disco zombie.note: LA techno DJ and producer active in the WORK / Dirty Epic underground orbit — dark, groovy techno; co-hosts the @earlyafters show on KCHUNG Radio.

onyx.note: LA-based underground techno DJ, active on the WORK / INCOGNITO circuit; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

rubbermiro.note: LA techno DJ (KCHUNG Radio earlyafters host alongside Disco Zombie) — dark, groovy underground techno; regular on the Dirty Epic / WORK circuit.

jayda g.note: Vancouver-born, London-based producer/DJ Jacinda Gulley — environmental toxicologist turned Grammy-nominated house and disco selector; two albums on Ninja Tune including 'Guy' (2023). An instinctive digger with genuine soul. Tracked name.

enayet.note: NYC-based, Dhaka-raised producer and SLINK co-founder — debut EP 'Chokkor' recorded in Bangladesh; polyrhythmic club music with South Asian vocal/percussion textures; collaborated with Daytimers and Talvin Singh.

k wata.note: NYC producer Kenzo Perron, SLINK co-founder — experimental grooves between warehouse electro, trap and psychedelic reggaeton; produced for Yaeji; contributed to james K 'Friend' remix album.

discostan.note: LA collective/label co-founded by Arshia Fatima Haq and Jeremy Loudenback — archives and decolonizes the dancefloor through South/West Asian and North African music: '80s diaspora disco, folkloric sounds, re-edits and political interventions. Featured in Pitchfork, The Guardian, KCRW.

pocari g.note: LA-based house DJ active on the local underground circuit; limited wider public footprint.

ashtre.note: LA-based selector on the local house/underground circuit; no verified label or broader profile found.

oso disco.note: LA disco/house DJ; included per billing, limited verifiable detail.

blaze claze.note: LA-based DJ; included per billing, no wider verifiable profile found.

halo varga.note: Brian Varga — Chicago-bred selector, one of fabric London's first resident DJs; releases on All Inn Records, Visionquest, Soma, Yoshitoshi; now San Diego-based and co-owner of Artifact Record Shop. Deep Chicago house roots with a European finish.

dylan payne.note: LA-based vinyl selector and Inthebagg label head — all-vinyl sets of house, microhouse and minimal grooves; Sunday Sessions LA regular.

highkin'.note: Moscow-born, LA-based vinyl collector and DJ — active on the LA underground circuit with an RA profile; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

flying mojito bros.note: British duo Ben Chetwood and Jack Sellen — cosmic country-funk and classic rock reimagined as acid house and modern disco; releases on Ubiquity, Paper Recordings, !K7 and Heavenly. Think Crosby Stills and Nash at the Hacienda.

brainstory.note: LA trio (Inland Empire origin) — jazz-inflected neo-soul, psychedelia and hip-hop textures; primarily a live band, not a DJ act. Some groove DNA but a different lane from the dance floor.

ginger root.note: Cameron Lew's solo project from Huntington Beach — immaculately crafted indie soul, alt-disco, boogie and Japanese city pop; primarily a live band but occasionally performs DJ sets. Influences include Vulfpeck, Toro y Moi and Yellow Magic Orchestra.

eli escobar.note: New York house and disco veteran — 20+ years in the scene, Tiki Disco crew founding member, Night People NYC label boss; sets traverse soulful disco, jazzy house, funk, reggaeton and Afrobeat without losing the floor.

amelie lens.note: Belgian techno figurehead — Exhale label boss; peak-time driving techno with melodic undertow, one of the genre's biggest live draws. Tracked.

charlotte de witte.note: Ghent-born, one of techno's biggest names — KNTXT label, relentlessly functional hard techno; consistently sells out rooms from Berghain to stadiums. Tracked.

anetha.note: Paris-based DJ/producer, founder of Mama Told Ya — hypnotic, industrial-leaning techno sitting between EBM and peak-time dancefloor; a respected European voice in the harder end.

dj seinfeld.note: Armand Jakobsson — lo-fi deep house producer turned selector, UK Garage and 140 edges on releases for 17 Steps and Lobster Fury. Tracked.

luuk van dijk.note: Dutch house DJ and Filth on Acid co-founder — driving, Rotterdam-flavored tech house and house; one of the harder-working Dutch acts on the festival circuit.

mau p.note: Dutch DJ/producer Maurits Philipsen — Parisian-style driving tech-house with pop-punk samples; huge Beatport runs ('Drugs From Amsterdam', 'Your Mind Is Fucked'); the mainstream end of the lane. Tracked.

maceo plex.note: Cuban-American Eric Estornel — Ellum Audio boss; melodic, cosmic techno that bridges Ibiza progressive and warehouse; long-running Dj-Kicks alumnus and Fabric resident.

vtss.note: Warsaw-born, Berlin-based Martyna Maja — fast, industrial EBM-adjacent techno with a fashion-forward aesthetic; Hessle Audio, Codes and her own Novaya imprint.

tiga.note: Montreal DJ/producer — Turbo Recordings boss, electro-disco-techno crossover ('You Gonna Want Me'); one of the more interesting veteran acts on a lineup this size.

vintage culture.note: Brazilian producer Luiz Cezar — melodic house and tech-house, massive streaming numbers and festival circuit presence. Tracked.

nick león.note: Miami-based producer — club music at the intersection of reggaeton, dembow and experimental electronic; Hyperdub-adjacent and critically acclaimed without the mainstream profile.

boys noize.note: Berlin DJ/producer Alexander Ridha — hard electro and techno, Boysnoize Records boss; long-running collab history (Daft Punk, Skrillex); reliable peak-time energy.

lee burridge.note: UK DJ and All Day I Dream label boss — melodic, cosmic, organic deep house that works best in long afternoon sets; one of the most tasteful festival-circuit selectors around.

radio slave.note: Matt Edwards — UK DJ/producer and Rekids label boss; known for hypnotic, long-form techno-house sets with roots in 90s Chicago and Detroit; 'Grindhouse' is a genre-defining peak-time track.

dj colette.note: Chicago house DJ and vocalist with years on the Defected circuit — soulful, vocal-forward deep house; a Chicago scene stalwart.

doc martin.note: LA techno and house veteran with 30+ years as Avalon Hollywood's longtime resident — one of the most respected names in American underground club music.

justin martin.note: San Francisco house and bass-house producer, Dirtybird co-signee — playful, groove-forward sets that sit between deep and tech.

mikey lion.note: Co-founder of Desert Hearts festival and label — melodic, organic, community-rooted house; a recognizable face in the All Day I Dream orbit.

township rebellion.note: German DJ duo Dario Noblesse and Uto Karem — longtime Ibiza residents (Amnesia, DC10) with releases on Cocoon, Mood, 8bit and Deeperfect; deep, hypnotic techno and house built for long sets. European pedigree and Ibiza circuit credibility are the real draw here.

rosie love.note: LA underground DJ and Apt4B Radio member — house and techno selector at no-phone electronic micro-fests in DTLA lofts and venues; local scene figure rather than a headliner name.

mike servito.note: Detroit-area DJ who's built a career on jacking, eclectic selections spanning house, acid, techno and new wave — residencies at Ghostly's Untitled, WORK and The Bunker NY; one of the more interesting American selectors in this space.

jason kendig.note: Detroit-born, now Chicago-based — core member of Honey Soundsystem (the queer dance music collective) and Smart Bar resident; his sets move between disco, house and atmospheric techno with genuine range. They've b2b'd at BASEMENT and other serious venues.

mura masa.note: Guernsey-born producer Alex Crossan — built his name on sample-savvy UK electronic that blends club rhythms with pop instincts; 2024 album 'Curve 1' shifted toward raw dancefloor energy. His DJ sets lean harder than the albums suggest; founded Pond Recordings (Peckham, 2024).

zepparella.note: All-female San Francisco-based Led Zeppelin tribute band — Nat Goldberg (drums, known as Clementine), Anna Kristina (vocals), Gretchen Menn (guitar), Holly West (bass); technically strong, heavy touring act in the tribute circuit.

adam spry.note: San Francisco-based multi-instrumentalist — nostalgic indie pop, folk and alt-rock; playing Gold Diggers in a three-act bill.

markus schulz.note: Czech-American trance DJ based in Miami — Coldharbour Recordings founder, Global DJ Broadcast radio host; annual open-to-close residency at Avalon Hollywood. One of trance's most committed marathon performers, but trance is not the lane.

beau didier.note: Amsterdam-based DJ/producer (born 1999) — his sound is bass-heavy hardgroove techno; releases on Molekül and Mutual Rytm, played HÖR Berlin, Awakenings and Vault Sessions; Vulged events co-founder. LA debut.

ötak.note: LA-based hardgroove/hard techno DJ, THERMAL resident — active on the CLOSER series; heavy back-to-back presence in this series.

kana hishiya.note: Japanese, LA-based selector and Dialogue resident — cornerstone of LA's underground with a wide arc from minimal and abstract broken beats to dark, driving house and techno. One of the more interesting local voices on an otherwise mixed bill.

bilaliwood.note: LA-based DJ Bilal Ali — plays Bar Franca, Grandmaster Recorders and the DJs for Climate Action circuit; groove-forward sets with a crate-digger's sensibility. Limited wider profile but a trusted local presence.

enola bedard.note: Quebec-born singer-songwriter with a large TikTok following — viral acoustic covers launched her career, now releasing original indie pop material. A pop act on the younger-fanbase end of the spectrum; not the lane.

dj slugo.note: One of the founding fathers of Chicago ghetto house and juke — 30+ years deep, CEO of Blok Club DJs, and a defining force in the raw 150-165 BPM body-music that predated and shaped footwork. Tracks like 'Where the Rats?' are canonical. A genuine originator, not a tourist.

scotty boy.note: Veteran DJ/producer Scott Schroer — 25+ years in the scene, three Billboard Dance #1s (including 'Shiny Disco Balls', 2014), Sirius XM radio, and Kiss Kiss Bang Bang resident. More polished and radio-house than underground; solid crowd-mover without much edge.

embrz.note: Dublin producer Jack Casey — 100M+ streams and BBC Radio 1 attention for his wistful, atmospheric take on melodic deep house; has toured with Lane 8 and SG Lewis and runs in the This Never Happened circuit. Not underground, but the rooftop day-party format suits his slow-burning style.

isaac carter.note: London-based selector and Ochi imprint founder — deep Chicago- and Detroit-inflected vocal house with a contemporary UK edge; championed by Ben UFO, Joy Orbison, Seth Troxler and Floating Points. He has an EP forthcoming on Bradley Zero's Rhythm Section label in 2026 — as inside the groove/European taste lane as a non-tracked name gets.

harrison bdp.note: Welsh producer Harrison Webber — outsider house, tech house and deep house on Shall Not Fade, Lost Palms and Phonica Recordings; NTS regular. A digger-oriented sound with some Glaswegian warehouse energy.

lubelski.note: LA native Jake Lubell — Dirtybird LP 'Happy Accidents' (2022), releases on Crosstown Rebels, Gruuv and Desert Hearts; percussive, analog-obsessed production and a Midnight Lovers fixture. One of the better local selectors.

phantoms.note: LA duo Kyle Kaplan and Vinnie Pergola — former teen actors turned electronic producers; their blend of house, indie-dance and French Touch pop sensibility earned 'Just A Feeling' (ft. VERITE) four weeks at US Dance Radio #1 and worldwide DJ support from Pete Tong and Diplo. Now on Ninja Tune. Fun and radio-friendly rather than underground.

dj rashida.note: Detroit-connected selector who toured globally as Prince's personal DJ — her eclecticism spans hip-hop, funk, soul, dancehall and house, and she has deep personal knowledge of the Prince catalog from years on the road with him. An ideal co-curator for this night.

man man.note: Philadelphia-born, now LA-based experimental indie band led by Honus Honus — known for switching instruments mid-set and channeling Beefheart, Zappa and Tom Waits through dense, theatric indie rock. Sub Pop release 'Carrot on Strings' dropped June 2024. Exactly the small-venue experimental-band lane taste.yaml wants surfaced.

oguz.note: Dutch-born DJ of Turkish descent (Oguz Gülcenbay) — hard techno with melodic crossover moments; played Berghain, Printworks, Hï Ibiza; 'GOLDEN SZN' cleared 20M streams. Skews harder and more festival-EDM-adjacent than the refined European techno end you typically favor.

tucker wetmore.note: Rising Bellingham, WA country-pop singer — 'Wine Into Whiskey,' 'Island'; Warner Nashville signee on a breakout trajectory; mainstream country with some heartland-rock edge.

william beckmann.note: Texas singer-songwriter in the traditional country mold — warm baritone, straightforward country songcraft with an honky-tonk lean.

noizu.note: UK-born (Jacob Plant), LA-based tech house producer — broke through on Chris Lake's Black Book Records with 'DANCE' (2019); OWSLA/Confession credits; runs his own Techné Records. Hard-hitting festival-ready tech house, firmly in the mainstream-fun end of the lane.

rachel chinouriri.note: Zimbabwean-British singer-songwriter from Croydon — debut album 'What a Devastating Turn of Events' (Parlophone, 2024) charted UK top 20 and landed her two BRIT nominations (Best New Artist, Artist of Year). Warm, confessional indie-pop with a soulful British sensibility.

katseye.note: Six-piece global girl group formed via the HYBE x Geffen 'Dream Academy' reality show (2023) — blends K-pop production values with Western pop; debut Billboard Hot 100 entry in 2025. More K-pop adjacent than indie or alternative.

doechii.note: Tampa rapper and Grammy winner (Best Rap Album 2025 for 'Alligator Bites Never Heal') — genre-fluid, confrontational, genuinely one of the most exciting MCs in the game right now.

noname.note: Chicago rapper Fatima Warner — Bronzeville-raised, started in YOUMedia alongside Chance the Rapper; 'Telefone' (2016) and 'Room 25' (2018) cemented her as one of the most distinct voices in conscious hip-hop; soft-spoken delivery over jazzy basslines, politically sharp lyrics. Also runs the Noname Book Club, a globally active radical reading group.

dj susan.note: San Diego-based DJ/producer Steven Glathe — 3 Billboard Dance chart #1s ('Shiny Disco Balls,' 'You're Not Alone,' 'Shine Your Love'); known for mixing deep, jackin and bass house; created the 'Deep House Brunch DTLA' series. More festival/mainstream tech-house than the digger-vinyl end.

rich medina.note: Philadelphia selector with one of the widest musical vocabularies in American DJing — Cornell-educated, BBE Music-affiliated; built his reputation on JNF (North America's original Fela Kuti-dedicated Afrobeat party), Lil' Ricky's Rib Shack at NYC's APT, and collaborations with Jill Scott and J Dilla. House, rare groove, soul, Afrobeat and garage classics all in a single night. 50,000+ pieces of vinyl and counting.

dublon.note: Oslo-based producer — jazz-inflected, feel-good melodic house; debut EP 'Nectar' on Delicieuse Musique, now on Ninja Tune's Technicolour imprint. Tracks like 'Summer in Marseille' and 'Belle' broke on TikTok; warm, speckled compositions that sit closer to listening-bar house than peak-time techno.

aaron paar.note: LA DJ since the early '90s, active in the city's soul/house underground ever since — Dublab-associated, vinyl-forward selector with a deep crate spanning soul, funk and house. A scene elder in the best sense.

clint stewart.note: Sunday Sessions LA vinyl-only resident — local house and deep house selector on the vinyl-only LA circuit.

yoffers.note: LA-based vinyl house DJ on the Sunday Sessions circuit; limited wider public footprint beyond the local underground scene.
